title: Implement evidence_bundle Record and Validator
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Define the evidence_bundle record exactly as the section 7 JSON model, with a validator that rejects missing or mistyped fields. Fields: verdict: str (e.g. "COLLAPSED"); timestamp: int (e.g. 1727575200); matrix_failures: list (e.g. ["Matrix 2: Zombie Deadlock detected on task WBS-04-12"]); stalled_task_id: str (e.g. "WBS-04-12"); stalled_duration_sec: int (e.g. 1895); system_memory_used_pct: float (e.g. 82.5); recovery_action: str (e.g. "TRIGGER_FABLE_RESUSCITATION"). verdict is the literal COLLAPSED, timestamp is integer epoch seconds, matrix_failures is a list of strings. Write the bundle atomically (temp file + os.replace) and mark it read-only so it is immutable.
